dedupe_keys.name: pownet v1 3 unit commitment economic dispatch model in python with data for cambodian power system

description: PowNet v1.3: Unit Commitment / Economic Dispatch model in Python with data for Cambodian power system is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors AFM Kamal Chowdhury, Jordan Kern (Singapore University of Technology and Design). PowNet is a least-cost optimization model for simulating the Unit Commitment and Economic Dispatch (UC/ED) of large-scale (regional to country) power systems. In PowNet, a power system is represented by a set of nodes that include power plants, high-voltage substations, and import/export stations (for cross-border systems). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
